name: id
business_description: Unique row identifier for this target allocation.

name: created_at
business_description: Timestamp when the record was created.

name: created_by
business_description: User who created the record.

name: modified_at
business_description: Timestamp when the record was last modified.

name: modified_by
business_description: User who last modified the record.

name: status
business_description: Lifecycle status of the target.

name: allocation_date
business_description: Date on which the allocation was made.

name: allocation_type
business_description: Type of allocation recorded.

name: assign_by
business_description: Identifier of the officer who assigned the target.

name: assign_to
business_description: Identifier of the officer the target was assigned to.

name: project_budget_amount
business_description: Budget allocated against the target.

name: project_remaining_amount
business_description: Budget remaining unspent against the target.

name: total_hysical
business_description: Total physical progress recorded; the field name appears to be a typo of total_physical.

name: departmental_scheme_id
business_description: Identifier of the departmental scheme the target belongs to.

name: financial_year_id
business_description: Identifier of the financial year the target belongs to.

name: module_type_id
business_description: Type of module the allocation was created under.

name: office_type_id
business_description: Type of office the target was assigned to.

name: parent_id
business_description: Identifier of the parent record in the allocation hierarchy.

name: umbrella_scheme_id
business_description: Identifier of the umbrella scheme the target rolls up into.

name: district_id
business_description: Identifier of the district the target is allocated for.

name: booking_level
business_description: Level at which the target applies, for example state, district or block.

name: store_type_id
business_description: Type of store the target applies to.
